Lina (Mktg): Quick sync: we need a concise benchmark narrative for next week's launch focused on latency vs cost tradeoffs. I sketched three micro-angles: "Instant UX", "Scale for cents", and "Enterprise predictability." Need chart asks + one-sentence lead for each.
Diego (Product): nice. For "Instant UX" call out 95th/99th p50 differences and prefix cache wins. For "Scale for cents" show batching + quantization delta. For "Enterprise predictability" include Dedicated throughput curve and a note about SLAs.
Priya (Growth): inbound CTAs should map: instant -> "Measure 99th latency", scale -> "Estimate cost per 1k calls", enterprise -> "Request SLA quote". I'll prepare 3 landing variants.
Evan (Design): chart idea: micro-sparklines inline with bullets + a single full-width comparison chart on slide 3. Use colorblind-safe palette. Can do mockups by tomorrow morning.
Ruth (Sales): Sales playbook needs two quick lines per angle and a demo command to reproduce numbers. Suggest: one-line benefit, one objection-response.
Lina (Mktg): example lead for "Instant UX": "Sub-200ms median without sacrificing quality: how Redwood routes and caches to keep chat instant." Short?
Diego (Product): good. Also add a sidenote: "auto-fallback to quantized variant reduces outages at cost of slight latency bump" — helps platform folks understand graceful degradation.
Priya (Growth): A/B test matrix: hero claim (emotional) vs hard-numbers (99th latency + $/1k). Also test CTA phrasing: "See my app's latency" vs "Calculate cost now".
Evan (Design): for the webinar, animate a slider that toggles batching-from-0-to-100% showing cost decline and tail latency shift. We'll call it "Batching slider demo."
Ruth (Sales): demo command suggestion: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"r-infer-6B","input":"hello"}'``` include note to enable prefix cache for best latency.
Lina (Mktg): OK action items: Evan -> 3 mocks + animation by tomorrow 10am. Diego -> confirm Dedicated throughput numbers + write 1-paragraph SRE blurb for footnote. Priya -> set up 3 landing pages + AB test plan. Ruth -> draft 2-liners for SDRs. I'll draft hero copy and the tweet.
assets-bot: Assets queued: marketing/bench-comparison-v1, slide-animation-batching -> staging 2026-04-03T09:00Z
Priya (Growth): Tweet draft: "Latency when users notice it, cost when your bill arrives. Redwood helps you optimize both across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Pocket guide -> <shortlink>"
Diego (Product): tiny nit: mention KV cache and prefix cache in the one-liner for credibility.
Lina (Mktg): added. Also let's include a 1-line footnote under charts: "Results depend on sequence length distribution and routing policy; see methodology link."
Evan (Design): noted for mock. I'll keep axis labels minimal and include tooltip annotations for the webinar.
Ruth (Sales): once assets are in staging, I'll run a quick enablement 15-min for SDRs to show the demo command and rebuttals.
Lina (Mktg): great. Reconv on Friday after design + numbers are in. :rocket:
